description: Security controls and the automated tests that check each one. `pnpm test:security` runs these tests and reports pass or fail per control (scripts/security-report.mjs). A control passes only when every listed test ran and passed. `suite` limits a file to the tests under that describe block.

controls.control: System instructions, the user's question and retrieved passages are kept apart; look-alike tags in user or document text are defused
Retrieved passages are labelled untrusted evidence; output that follows a document's instructions (unsupported claims, foreign links, invented sources) is removed or the answer is withheld
Text a reader cannot see (hidden elements, comments, scripts, attributes) is not indexed; nothing a page refers to is fetched
Question length limit, request-size limit (declared and streamed), content-type and schema validation; parser errors are not echoed
Unicode normalisation; control and direction-override characters removed from questions, sources and card text
Per-user rate limits (questions and feedback) and a concurrency cap, keyed by the validated identity
Model output is never rendered as HTML or Markdown: JSON responses with no-sniff headers, plain-text runs in Adaptive Cards, card templates defused

tests.suite: attack: script and markup in model output

controls.control: Citations come from retrieved chunks only; unknown or invented sources are dropped; links are https on allowlisted Moodle hosts
Secure response headers on the API, the bot and the administration page; no cross-origin access (no CORS headers, preflight refused)
Browser mutations on the administration page need a bearer token (no cookies), a same-origin Origin header and explicit confirmation for destructive actions
Request timeout and dependency timeouts (Moodle, readiness probes); HTTPS required for every service URL in production
Error responses carry a code, a fixed message and a reference only: no exception text, stack, URL or credential; failures are logged with secrets redacted

Only Moodle file URLs on the configured site are downloaded; redirects only to approved hosts; loopback, link-local and metadata addresses refused; the token never leaves the Moodle host; no API accepts a URL

tests.suite: attack: SSRF through a download URL

controls.control: Download paths are limited to Moodle's file endpoints; traversal, other endpoints and injected credentials are refused
Content type decided from the bytes, not the declared type; input-size limit; parser timeout; unsupported and encrypted files reported, not parsed
Archives (docx, pptx): entry-count, per-entry and total decompression limits, compression-ratio check, traversal-safe entry names, encrypted entries refused
Entra tokens: signature, issuer, audience, tenant, expiry, version, scope and calling app are validated; identity comes only from the validated token; unknown users are refused
Course filtering happens before retrieval, from Moodle enrolments; a course the user is not enrolled in is refused; it fails closed when Moodle cannot confirm
Administration actions are checked server-side against app roles in the token, for every endpoint and role

Configuration is validated at start-up and reported by variable name only; every secret setting is registered for redaction; nothing sensitive reaches logs or telemetry; source files carry no invisible or direction-override characters
Deployed services read secrets from Key Vault with managed identities; Azure AI Search keys are disabled; nothing tenant-specific or secret is committed; committed files are scanned for secrets
